summary: Parabilis Medicines, Inc. filed an 8-K on November 5, 2026, disclosing a Third Amendment of Lease dated October 30, 2026 with LS 400/500 CDP, LLC covering its Cambridge, Massachusetts headquarters. The amendment expands leased space by 33,525 square feet at 20 Acorn Park Drive beginning January 1, 2028, with rent commencing January 1, 2029, extends the term through December 31, 2037 from March 1, 2031, and provides eight months of base rent abatement plus extension options. This is a routine real-estate contract, not a special situation; no deal terms apply.
